quotes.text: I wouldn't hijack the tabindex for these and let the roving tab respect the visual hierarchy of these buttons.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For the new address-book pane header, keep normal visual-order navigation instead of assigning custom tabindex values to reorder actions. Review requested this and accepted the final button markup. NewBook opens its menu on ordinary click. HTML buttons listen for click, while XUL menu items still use command. Preserve the distinction when replacing XUL toolbars with HTML. Scope: these controls and matching component patterns. Purposeful roving-focus widgets can require different navigation.
title: Let new pane buttons follow visual keyboard order
